mapper.select: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS request_count, SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost, AVG(latency_ms) AS avg_latency_ms FROM model_usage_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY stat_date ASC
